final_note: You learned about main UK religions and the trend of secularisation.

concepts.def: Major world religion in UK too

walkthroughs.body_html:
Largest UK faiths (2021 Census):

  • Christianity ~46%.
  • Islam ~6%.
  • Hinduism ~1.7%.
  • Sikhism, Judaism, Buddhism — smaller numbers.

'No religion' ~37%.

Religion can give:

  • Sense of meaning.
  • Community.
  • Moral guidance.
  • Comfort in tough times.

Secularisation = society becoming less religious.

UK trends: fewer attend church, more say 'no religion'.

But other religions (especially Islam) have grown. 🕌
